page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block at top; below it an epigraph line, a motto in italic; centred woodcut of an anchor with serpent in the middle; imprint centred below the woodcut. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ex Verbo Dei, partim ex Patribus Or-
Augustinus lib. Quaestionum in Matth. cap.II.
Boni Catholici sunt, qui & fidem integram sequuntur,

page.notes: Woodcut of an anchor entwined with a serpent, flanked by two figures, placed between the motto and the imprint. The title words "SYMBOLI APOSTOLICI" are set in large capitals with the hyphens printed at line ends. The printed "Thesibus" and "Verbo" are as printed.
